answer: A mining claim is admitted only after ClaimLedger matches the staked corner monuments against the serial filed at the land office and county recorder, refusing any serial already tied to a seat. The penalty trigger is a duplicate serial or a corner restaked over a live claim, voiding both filings and the bond. Filing costs two hundred twelve dollars, upkeep one sixty five, and a survey six hundred, so N fakes cost N times nine seventy seven dollars plus N survey days. No oasis of paperwork skips it, a basalt outcrop holds one monument, and the core vault keeps one sample per claim.
